tests.name: Spline keyframes hit exact authored values
Monotone segment never overshoots
Reversing spline has bounded extremum
Vector track has independent bounded coordinates
Fractional frames really differ
Authored full revolution is not shortest-arc collapsed
Before/after track clamp at endpoint
Hold retains exact earlier key until endpoint
Pure sampling does not mutate keyframe input
Fractional turn weights continuously sum to one
Ribcage never collapses to zero-width card
Head offset lags body by independently authored yaw
Front/profile/back endpoints are unambiguous
Opaque clipping bands exactly cover width without overlap
Equivalent revolutions have same silhouette projection
Shoulder projection crosses depth only at edge-on
IK chains remain finite and preserve lengths at every view
Seeded randomness reproducible without global RNG
Different particle births have different deterministic samples
Particle absent before birth and at expiry
Particle analytic rewind returns exact same output
Particle age uses fractional frame, not render-call count
Drag reduces travel compared with zero drag
Particle sample cannot alter emitter definition
